Quick one. Please what is the difference between the function of a slicer and the filter
A slicer is a way to visualise and apply a filter to a chart. Filters generally allow you to group data, show top x visuals, and categorise data for a visual or for an entire report.
A slicer in Power BI is a visual. You drop categorical data which helps you filter your data.. A filter is not a visual.
